blurb: The Spanish royal collection, with the world's best Velázquez, Goya and Titian.

facts.t: King Ferdinand VII opened the royal picture collection to the public in a building first designed for a natural history museum. 311 Spanish paintings were shown on the first day.
Velázquez painted the little Infanta Margarita and her maids in 1656, with himself at a huge easel and the king and queen reflected in a mirror. Picasso painted 58 versions of it in 1957.
